description: Short gate keywords must match whole words: embrace/trace are not race, majority is not major, statement is not state, capacity is not city, advisable is not visa. Ordinary free-response prompts stay free_text instead of tripping demographic/education/location/sponsorship gates.

fields.label: How do you plan to embrace our culture?

What is your capacity for on-call work?
Do you have experience with advisable cloud patterns?
